milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the pink glazed terracotta block (front wall at ~6,~1,~3) and face toward it, confirming visual identification. Target is the front-wall pink block which is closest to spawn and most likely to be spotted first. max_distance=8 ensures the player has walked close enough to clearly see the distinctive pink swirl pattern, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it.
